heading: Report to Congress
lead: The Secretary of Transportation shall submit to Congress an annual report to accompany the President’s budget request that—

tree.text: describes all activities undertaken under this chapter, including a description of the process for the application for and approval of licenses under this chapter and recommendations for legislation that may further commercial launches and reentries; and
reviews the performance of the regulatory activities and the effectiveness of the Office of Commercial Space Transportation.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2010—Pub. L. 111–314 successively renumbered section 70121 of title 49 and section 70121 of this title as this section.
